digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and container scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared none is neutral and contributes no paths; it does not poison sibling path declarations or force whole-HEAD invalidation
A live child declared undeclared poisons child path inheritance and prevents parent promotion to all-none scope; any live undeclared child preserves conservative unscoped fallback
All-none scope is signed only when at least one live child exists and every live child is authenticated none; no live children does not synthesize all-none
Parent-owned paths take dependency precedence over all-none children; an explicit parent paths declaration remains signed and does not synthesize file-scope:none
Mixed live paths and none children sign only the path child dependencies and survive unrelated file drift; they become stale when a declared child path changes

Cheap resign preserves child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads; P9 passes declared-none leaves and all-declared containers, advising only live undeclared children as poisoners
